name: The deed to Prosperity
note: Doc 23, and the display name is CONFIRMED there rather than provisional. Acquired at puzzle A3; doc 02's ledger says it cannot be lost. Doc 23 note 2: THAD names the claim, the deed does not -- nothing may imply Vessel sold him something already called Prosperity.

LOOK_AT.say: A deed to forty feet of ground, drawn by hand, the boundary described as ‘from the stake, thereabouts.’
repeat: Claim Two. I have written Prosperity across the top myself, in pencil, which I am aware changes nothing.
Signed by Deke Vessel and witnessed by nobody at all.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper. It cost me four dollars and my father’s watch.
repeat: Nothing. It is a legal document and it is not going to help me.
